name: Cala Pregonda
description: One of the north coast's most iconic coves: reddish sand, islets just offshore and an almost lunar feel. It has no facilities, and that is precisely its charm.

practicalInfo.acceso: On foot, about 30 min from the Binimel·là car park
practicalInfo.aparcamiento: It has no car park of its own: you leave the car at Binimel·là and walk for about 30 minutes. That car park is capacity-controlled (2026 season) and closes when full, so the space you need is not Pregonda's but Binimel·là's, and it serves two beaches at once. There is no point looking for a spot nearby: the lanes are narrow and parking on them is not allowed.
practicalInfo.servicios: None: bring water, food and shade
practicalInfo.mejorEpoca: May, June and September. In August, first thing: if Binimel·là is already closed, Pregonda stops being an option for that day. Access control runs from 7.30am to 9pm and stays in place until 15 October.

planner.effortNote: No road access to the cove: ~30 min walk (2 km) along the Camí de Cavalls from the Binimel·la car park. No services; sturdy footwear, water and shade are essential.
planner.seasonalHours: June or September; in July/August the Binimel·la car park fills up early. Best with little northerly wind.
